Destinations / Rajasthan

Rajasthan

Forts, palaces and golden desert nights

Best time: October – March. Wide highways, forts kids love and desert camps with folk music. Avoid April–June heat.

Highlights

  • Amber Fort in Jaipur
  • Sam sand dunes near Jaisalmer
  • Lake palaces of Udaipur
  • Blue city of Jodhpur

Suggested road trips

Royal Rajasthan loop

10 days · about 1,400 km. Jaipur → Jodhpur → Jaisalmer → Udaipur → back to Jaipur via Pushkar.

  1. Jaipur → Jaipur forts (30 km, about 1.5 h)
  2. Jaipur → Pushkar (145 km, about 3 h)
  3. Pushkar → Jodhpur (190 km, about 4 h)
  4. Jodhpur → Mehrangarh (10 km, about 0.5 h)
  5. Jodhpur → Jaisalmer (285 km, about 5 h)
  6. Jaisalmer → Sam dunes (45 km, about 1 h)
  7. Jaisalmer → Jodhpur (285 km, about 5 h)
  8. Jodhpur → Udaipur via Ranakpur (250 km, about 6 h)
  9. Udaipur → Udaipur lakes (10 km, about 0.5 h)
  10. Udaipur → Jaipur (395 km, about 7 h)

Jaipur & Ranthambore weekend

3 days · about 360 km. Palaces, then two tiger safaris.

Before you go

Low; desert heat from April to June (40 °C+). Travel October–March.

Good on highways; sparse west of Jaisalmer towards the dunes.

Excellent highways; watch for cattle and camels, especially at night.
